desc: The CZ Shadow 2 Target Limited is a precision-engineered pistol crafted for competitive shooters and enthusiasts seeking superior accuracy and control. Built on the renowned Shadow 2 platform, this limited-edition model features upgraded ergonomics, enhanced sights, and a finely-tuned trigger for faster, more accurate shots. Its stylish, high-quality finish and exclusive details make it a standout choice for those serious about performance and style.
